resources.string: Ari\'s charts and dashboards show as cards in the chat, drawn as they are today. Open one to see it whole, or share it as a picture or a PDF.
Make your own charts: type the numbers or have them read from your records, and see the chart change as you go.
Dashboards put several charts and text on one page: arrange them, pick their colours, and ask Ari for a link to share.
